Duration.description: A length of time: "1.5s", "200ms", "2m", "1h", or a number of seconds

GoalKind.description:
What kind of goal the client draws (the goal type in QuestFullUpdateIIR,
`quests::*QuestGoal::GetGoalType`).

oneOf.description: Defeat an enemy (12, "destroy character"); the tracker names it.
Anything the server decides (22, "external trigger"): most area quests.

wait.description:
Waits until the player has the goal (Lua 1699's buff, whose script 4005 retries every
second); otherwise it counts only if the player has it then.

QuestGoal.description: One goal of a quest step.

anywhere.description: Counts anywhere in the world; otherwise only inside the quest's area.

counts.description:
What counts toward it, as an achievement's `counts`: `kills`, `smashes`, `builds` or
`kills_or_smashes`; `pickups`: picking up one of `pickups` (the client's quest pickup
Lua: QuestTriggerProgress by `max / count` each). None: nothing the server counts yet.

dropped_by.description:
`counts: pickups`: what drops them while the quest runs (`kills`, `smashes` or
`kills_or_smashes`, of `enemies`), one each with tunables `story.pickup_drop_chance`.
Not in the client (docs/TUNABLES.md).

enemies.description:
The enemies or smashables that count, by name (`@<category>` for a smash rule category's);
empty: any. For `pickups`: the ones that drop them.

hash.description: The client's hash of the goal (`resolvegoal <hash>` in dialogue texts).

max.description:
The progress bar's maximum the client shows (live: 100 for most area quests); each one
counted adds `max / count` rounded up. None: the count.

pickups.description: `counts: pickups`: the quest pickup items (client item templates, "XX_Quest Pickup ...").

text.description: The client's goal text (TDB 50304): what the tracker shows.

QuestKind.description: How the client's quest tracker shows a quest (the main quest's type, MainQuestUpdateIIR_c).

oneOf.description:
A world's story line (client type 5): gold compass, gold text and progress bar; hidden in
the Lost Creations.

An area quest (client type 1): silver compass (in the Lost Creations the "endless" one),
white text, blue progress bar. Runs while the player is in its `area`.
A test or development quest of the client's data (client types 0, 3, 4): never started.

QuestMarker.description: Where a goal's minimap arrow points.

district.description: The district the tracker names (TDB 51200 instance), as live sent it.

playfield.description: The playfield it is in; none: the quest's area's.

QuestStep.description: One quest of a main quest (the client's "quest"; a story line's step).

rewards.description: Rewards of this step alone (template, category), shown in the tracker; not given yet.

source.description: Where its place in a story line comes from (`live`: the capture's order, `guess`).

task.description: The client's task name and description (TDB 50301, 50302), when they say something.

RewardScript.description: What an area quest's reward item runs on completion (its spell's Lua script, RDB 1010223).

progress.description: Story goals it advances if the player has them (`QuestTriggerProgress(hash, n)`).

solves.description: Story goals it solves if the player is on them (`solvegoal`), by goal hash.

tags.description: Tags it adds (`player:addtag`): story pushers (a talking head shows) ...

tags_if_goal.description: ... only if the player has one of these story goals (by hash); empty: always.

Source.description: Where a value came from, so guesses stay visible next to what live did.

oneOf.description: Extracted from the game client's data.
Seen in a capture of the live server (LMO_Captures.cap).
Seen in the recorded 2015 demo session.
Taken from video footage of live.
Values the server used before they were moved into content (docs/TUNABLES.md).
Proposed by a tool from client data (navmesh, names, ...), not seen live.
Placed or confirmed by someone in the world editor.

description:
A main quest (the client's quest giver list, RDB 1000104): a world's story line or an
area quest, its quests in order (`steps`) and their goals: `quests/<slug>.json`.

area.description: An area quest's region: entering it starts the quest (or resumes it), leaving pauses it.

client_name.description: The client's internal name ("[Pirate 1] Free the pirate prisoners").

cooldown.description: How long after completing it before it starts again.

extends.description: Another record of the same kind this one starts from: its fields, then this one's on top.

feature.description:
The feature it belongs to: `live` (recreating live), `feature/...` or `other/...`.
A record with the id of one in a parent feature changes it while this feature is on.

id.description: Its id: `quest/<slug>`. Stable: other records refer to it.

repeatable.description: Can be done again after its cooldown.

rev.description: Revision, raised by every saved edit (for merging concurrent edits).

reward_script.description:
What its reward item's Lua script does when the quest is completed (story pushers,
story goals).

rewards.description: The client's rewards (template, category) as its data lists them; not given yet.

updated.description: Unix time of the last edit.
